title: Kurt's forgotten childhood in gifted and talented program

tellings.quote:
I I have no idea. I don't remember a
single part of it.

plain: The comedian Kurt Metzger says he was placed in a gifted and talented program as a child in New Jersey, but has no memory of it at all: "I don't remember a single part of it." He tells it about himself on an episode about secret programs, where a blank like that hints that something was done to him he cannot recall.
